listing.name: Forza Motorsport 2 — Forza Motorsport 2 ReGPU (zer0ducksgiven)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, intro, menus, races and save profiles, with hardware-specific performance. High-frame-rate, 4K and ultrawide claims have not been confirmed by Portcove. Racing-wheel support is beta. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European Xbox 360 Forza Motorsport 2 ISO and matching mandatory TU_16L61VA_... title update. DLC is optional and must be your own. This guide has only an abbreviated default.xex SHA-256, 9726066f...9b120a; obtain the full XEX and title-update hashes from the importer before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use FM2-Setup-0.3.0.exe to import your ISO, title update and optional DLC. It builds local game files and installs portable Python. The launcher requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime, installed with Microsoft’s installer if missing, and WebView2. Use Windows 10/11 x64 with Direct3D 12 feature level 12_0. This is the native kernel/XAM and ReGPU project, a separate implementation from ReXGlue-based Forza 2.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, intro, menus, races and save profiles, with hardware-specific performance. High-frame-rate, 4K and ultrawide claims have not been confirmed by Portcove. Racing-wheel support is beta.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
